purpose: Four variations of the user-selected Source Index direction; concept mockups only.

variants.title: A · Margin Index
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one exceptionally polished, realistic desktop website screenshot, 1536 x 1152, straight on, no browser chrome, no device frame, no annotations or option labels.
Image 1 is the user's preferred Source Index design, a stylistic and structural reference. Preserve its identity: an understated left navigation rail, an editorial project directory, small numbered entries, strong typographic alignment, generous outer margins, green text links and readable technical descriptions. Evolve it into the specified variation; do not merely recolor the reference.
This is chong.md, a technical person's private garden in Sydney. It must feel carefully authored and lived in, not like a startup landing page, design-system template or an AI-generated portfolio. No marketing hero, giant headline, gradients, rounded cards, badges, bento grids, ornamental icons, plant drawings, simulated terminal, invented posts, fake update dates or decorative charts.
Keep the real controls: 'projects', 'about', 'style'. Brand 'chong.md', location 'Sydney', footer 'github/xnmp' and 'chonw@proton.me'. The intro is modest, 'I build the software I want to use, then measure it.' Small supporting sentence 'Tools, games, and notes from the work.'
Real linked entries with concise descriptions: 'Tauri Explorer' / 'A keyboard-first file manager.' / 'Rust · Svelte · alpha'; 'Scrivo' / 'A markdown editor that never reformats.' / 'Rust · CodeMirror'; 'Ballast' / 'A mood diary made of markdown files.' / 'Local-first · Android'; 'LambdaQuery' / 'Python comprehensions, compiled to SQL.' / 'Python · compiler'; group 'Games & agents': 'Brood War' / 'Replay-to-policy pipeline. The corrected win rate is 6%.'; 'Zheng Shang You' / 'Teaching a network the family card game.'; 'Eskiv' / 'A brute-force AI that plays a dodger.'
Keep all important text legible, with fine optical spacing and a personal research-index character. Avoid huge empty gaps inside the list. Do not invent controls or content. Variation A: MARGIN INDEX. The closest refinement of the preferred design, with the product image much quieter. Warm white #fafaf7, black ink, evergreen #245c48 links. The narrow rail starts at x=180; main content begins around x=470, overall maximum width 1160. Use 25px normal-weight humanist sans for the two-line intro, 19px elegant serif project links, 15px readable sans descriptions and 11–12px monospaced numbers/stack metadata. Each entry occupies a carefully spaced 70–90px text row; only group boundaries have faint hairlines. For the Tauri Explorer entry use a small 320x200 screenshot to the right of its description, aligned to the row, allowing the rest of the directory to begin much higher than Image 1. Image 2 is the actual Tauri Explorer quick-open capture, a supporting product asset: use it faithfully for that inset, retaining its actual README.md quick-open palette rather than inventing a Finder window. Keep the entire list and quiet footer within the canvas. The result should feel inevitable, subtly asymmetric, spacious outside and precise inside.
